title: Serializer1D
text: Convert vector signal to scalar or smaller vectors, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Input signal type} sets Input signal type of the block; {Ratio (Output Vector Size/Input Vector Size)} sets the ratio of input vector size to output vector, {Idle Cycles} sets the number of idle cycles, {StartIn}, {ValidIn}, {ValidOut}, {Input data port dimensions (-1 for inherited)} sets the size of the input data signal and {Input sample time (-1 for inherited)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: P
ports.summary: Parallel data input signal scalar | vector

ports.name: S
ports.summary: Serialized data output signal scalar | vector

params.name: Ratio (Output Vector Size/Input Vector Size)
params.values: Ratio of input vector size to output vector size 1 (default)

params.name: StartIn
params.values: Enable StartIn control port off (default) | on

params.name: ValidIn
params.values: Enable ValidIn control port off (default) | on

params.name: ValidOut
params.values: Enable ValidOut control port off (default) | on

params.name: Input data port dimensions (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Size of the input data signal -1 (default)

params.name: Input signal type
params.values: Input signal type of the block auto (default) | real | complex
